The Fear of Hadhrat Thaabit bin Qais (RA) and the Glad Tidings Rasulullaah ﷺ Gave him

Hadhrat Anas bin Maalik (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ did not see Hadhrat Thaabit bin Qais (RA) for awhile, a Sahabi (RA) volunteered to make enquiries about him. When the Sahabi (RA) came to Hadhrat Thaabit bin Qais (RA), he found him sitting in his house with head bent down. "What's the matter?" he asked. "Bad," replied Hadhrat Thaabit (RA), "because I raise my voice above that of Rasulullaah ﷺ, all my deeds are destroyed and I am amongst the inmates of Jahannam." (This he felt because of a verse of the Qur'aan referring to people who deliberately raise their voices above that of Rasulullaah ﷺ). The Sahabi (RA) then reported back to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Moosa bin Anas reports that the Sahabi (RA) returned a second time to Hadhrat Thaabit bin Qais (RA) with glad tidings from Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ instructed the Sahabi (RA) to inform Hadhrat Thaabit (RA) that far from being and inmate of Jahannam, he will be amongst the inhabitants of Jannah.[^2]
The daughter of Hadhrat Thaabit bin Qais bin Shammaas (RA) narrates from her father that he became extremely worried when he heard the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُوْرٍ
blocks.text: Verily Allaah detests every arrogant boaster.

He then locked himself in his house and started to weep. When Rasulullaah ﷺ was informed about this, Rasulullaah ﷺ called for him and he explained to Rasulullaah ﷺ what it was that worried him. He said, "I am a man who loves beauty and to be the leader of my people." Rasulullaah ﷺ reassured him saying, "You are not amongst those (arrogant and boastful) people. Your life shall be good, your death shall be good and Allaah shall enter you into Jannah."
Hadhrat Thaabit (RA) then did the same thing when Allaah revealed the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَرْفَعُوْٓا اَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوْا لَهٗ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ اَنْ تَحْبَطَ اَعْمَالُكُمْ وَاَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُوْنَ
blocks.text: O you who have Imaan! Never raise your voices above the voice of the Rasool ﷺ (literally and figuratively) and do not speak to him loudly as you speak loudly with each other, lest your deeds be laid to waste without your realising it.

When Rasulullaah ﷺ was informed about this, Rasulullaah ﷺ again called for him and he explained to Rasulullaah ﷺ what it was that worried him.
